end.parentNote: Myra practised comparing side lengths, angles and diagonals, and classifying quadrilaterals. They identified opposite equal sides in a parallelogram and four equal sides in a rhombus, but continued to say that a rhombus must be slanted and cannot be a square; this was not corrected by the end. Myra also reported being hit when a parent is angry and feeling afraid to go home; they said they were safe during the lesson. Please follow your safeguarding procedure and check in with Myra through a safe, appropriate adult. At home, use examples of both square and tilted rhombi to discuss that appearance does not change the defining properties.
